kaps_punt: inheemse, tradisionele huise [...] maak gebruik van 'n raamwerk van stutte (soos takke)

items.bewering: 'n Handvol gras kan nie op sy eie regop staan nie, en 'n mat ook nie. [...] Die bouers sit eers 'n raam van stutte op en bedek hom daarna.
items.blok: Wat 'n huis van gras regop hou
items.bron: Allgemeine Zeitung (Namibia), 'Nama women build beautiful matjies huts in the Richtersveld' (az.com.na): holes are dug in a circle and the poles set first, then the mats are draped over the frame; Ditsong Museums, Zulu dwellings (ditsong.org.za): the dome is built of bent wooden poles and then thatched. The order is frame first, covering after.

items.bewering: Tog staan daar huise van gras, riet en matte wat jare lank hou.
items.blok: Wat 'n huis van gras regop hou
items.bron: The Citizen (citizen.co.za) property columns, 'The advantages and disadvantages of thatched roofs', 2022: a maintained grass-thatched roof lasts 15 years or more, and often decades. 'Jare lank' is the cautious version and holds.

items.bewering: Die stutte van so 'n raam is dikwels boomtakke. Die raam hou die huis regop, en die bedekking hou die reën en wind buite.
items.blok: Wat 'n huis van gras regop hou
items.bron: CAPS NWT Gr 4-6 (Afrikaans), p. 22, Gr 4 Kwartaal 2, Sterk raamstrukture: 'maak gebruik van 'n raamwerk van stutte (soos takke)'. Wikipedia, 'Rondavel': the roof poles are 'taken from tree limbs'. Scouts SA wiki, 'Zulu huts': the frame is made of saplings.

items.bewering: In die vorige les het jy dieselfde idee by dakkappe en brûe gesien: rame van dun dele.
items.blok: Waar jy hierdie raam al gesien het
items.bron: CAPS NWT Gr 4-6, p. 22: 'stutte word verbind in driehoekige vorms wat 'n sterk, stabiele struktuur vorm, soos in dakkappe, brûe, hyskrane, kragmaste en geraamtes'. This confirms the factual part: roof trusses and bridges are frames of struts. Whether the previous lesson really covered them is a cross-reference between lessons, and I cannot check that from here.

items.bewering: Party hyskrane se lang arm is ook so 'n raam.
items.blok: Waar jy hierdie raam al gesien het
items.bron: Google Patents US10472213B2 'Lattice boom' and US9738495B2 'Lattice piece for a lattice boom, lattice boom and crane': a crane boom built as a lattice of chord and lattice members. 'Party' is right, because many crane booms are solid box sections instead.

items.bewering: Baie kragmaste is nog sulke rame, en hulle dun dele is reguit stukke staal.
items.blok: Waar jy hierdie raam al gesien het
items.bron: University of Liège, M.-Z. Bezas PhD (uee.uliege.be): 'an electric transmission tower made of angle section members'; ArcelorMittal/ANGELHY project: steel angle sections are used extensively in lattice towers for electricity transmission. Straight steel members, as the lesson says.

items.bewering: Die stutte van die huise in hierdie les is van hout en nie van staal nie.
items.blok: Waar jy hierdie raam al gesien het
items.bron: az.com.na (Nama matjieshuis: branches cut, stripped and bent); Ditsong Museums (Zulu dome: bent wooden poles); Wikipedia 'Rondavel' (roof poles from tree limbs).

items.bewering: 'n Tak is lank en dun, en hy is styf genoeg om gewig te dra. 'n Jong groen tak kan nog buig sonder om te breek.
items.bron: Popular Woodworking, 'Rustic chair': green wood keeps its moisture and is easier to bend than dried wood, and saplings suit bending; University of Galway, study of green Sitka spruce: green wood has markedly lower bending stiffness than dry timber.

items.bewering: Jong takke word daarom gebuig en in die regte vorm vasgebind. Die takke bly in daardie vorm, en hulle dra steeds gewig. So kan 'n raam van hout 'n ronde koepel word.
items.bron: Woodworker's Journal, 'Green Lumber: What Can I Do With It?': wood that has seasoned holds its shape stubbornly; az.com.na: Nama builders pin the bent branches for days so they set; Ditsong Museums: Zulu dome huts of bent poles tied with braided reed and grass.

items.bewering: Die woord inheems beteken dat iets van hierdie land self kom. 'n Inheemse huis is nie 'n soort huis wat van elders gebring is nie.
items.bron: Wiktionary 'inheems' (the shared Dutch/Afrikaans word): 'van oorsprong ergens voorkomend' = native, indigenous; Interglot: native, indigenous, endemic. 'Van hierdie land self' is a fair simplification of 'originating in the place'.

items.bewering: Die woord tradisioneel beteken dat 'n gemeenskap 'n manier van bou lank bewaar en aan jonger mense oordra. Ouers wys dit vir hulle kinders, en so gaan dit van mens tot mens aan.
items.bron: Dictionary.com 'tradition': 'the handing down of [...] customs [...] from generation to generation, especially by word of mouth or by practice'; Collins (same page): customs kept by a people 'over a relatively long period'.

items.bewering: Al drie die huise in hierdie les is inheems en tradisioneel.
items.bron: CAPS NWT Gr 4-6, p. 22: 'inheemse, tradisionele huise soos 'n Zoeloe-hut (uguqa), Xhosa (rontabile en ungqu-phantsi) en Nama (matjieshuis)'.

items.bewering: 'n Zoeloe-grashuis is rond, en die hele huis buig soos 'n koepel. [...] Sy raam bestaan uit jong takke wat gebuig en vasgebind word.
items.bron: Ditsong Museums (ditsong.org.za, Zulu dwellings): dome-shaped huts of bent wooden poles, tied with braided split reeds and grass, then thatched; Scouts SA wiki 'Zulu huts': a reconstructed hut with a frame of black wattle saplings lashed with soaked Natal fig bark.

items.bewering: Hierdie huis se eie naam in isiZulu is iqhugwane.
items.bron: Sources disagree on the name and its spelling. Ditsong Museums (a national museum) spells it 'iqukwane' (also 'iqukwhane') and gives 'quka' as another name. The CAPS document itself (NWT Gr 4-6, p. 22) names the Zulu hut 'uguqa'. Only one result, a non-authoritative page, used 'iQhugwane'. I found no isiZulu dictionary entry for any of these forms. The same headword appears in the 'iqhugwane' glossary entry and in the word list.
items.regstelling: A person, preferably an isiZulu speaker, should settle the spelling. Iqukwane (Ditsong) and uguqa (the CAPS word, which learners may meet in assessment) are both better supported than iqhugwane. Until then the sentence should not present one form as the house's only name: 'een naam' would be safer than 'se eie naam'.

items.bewering: 'n Rondawel is 'n ronde huis met 'n muur en 'n grasdak bo-op. Die Xhosa-huis in hierdie les is so 'n rondawel.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Rondavel': round, a 'cone on cylinder' with a wall and a thatched roof; CAPS NWT Gr 4-6, p. 22, names the Xhosa 'rontabile' (rondavel) as one of its examples. Franco Frescura, Glossary of Xhosa terms (sahistory.org.za), describes Xhosa conical roof structures.

items.bewering: Sy dak is self 'n raam van pale wat op die muur rus. Die pale loop skuins van die muur af boontoe en kom in een punt bymekaar. Die dak word van buite met gras gedek.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Rondavel': the principals are 'wooden poles running radially out from the apex of the roof to the top of the rondavel's wall', and the thatch 'is sewn to the poles with grass rope'. Frescura, Glossary of Xhosa terms: uphahla (rafter), ipontshi (the apex of the conical roof), isiphambano (a cross-brace tying the four main rafters).

items.bewering: Soos 'n dakkap het hierdie dak sy eie raam onder sy bedekking.
items.bron: Mapping checked. A roof truss is a frame of struts that carries a separate roof covering (CAPS p. 22 lists dakkappe as frame structures). The rondavel roof is a frame of rafters carrying sewn-on thatch (Wikipedia 'Rondavel'). The comparison claims only 'a frame under its covering', and that holds. It does not suggest the rondavel roof is triangulated the way a truss is, so a learner who reasons further is not misled.

items.bewering: Die Nama-huis is 'n ronde koepel wat tot op die grond kom. Die Afrikaanse naam vir hierdie huis is matjieshuis. Die Nama het hulle eie naam daarvoor in hulle eie taal, Khoekhoegowab.
items.bron: Dictionary of South African English (dsae.co.za), 'matjieshuisie' and 'mat-house': from Afrikaans matjie + huis, 'a typical Namaqualand matjieshuis [...] in traditional beehive form', 'hut of reed mats'; az.com.na: the beehive shape; a Richtersveld tourism page gives the local name !haru oms; Wikipedia 'Khoekhoe language': Khoekhoegowab is the language of the Nama and Damara.

items.bewering: Stokke word in 'n sirkel geplant en na binne gebuig. Hulle word vasgebind, en die raam word met geweefde rietmatte gedek.
items.bron: az.com.na: holes are dug in a circle, the poles are set in them and bent, and the tips are fastened crosswise in a beehive shape; the mats 'would be woven' from river reeds. Note for a person: the method that article then describes is closer to stitching (an awl pushed through two or three rushes, thread pulled through), but published sources consistently call the mats woven, so 'geweefde' stands.

items.bewering: stut: 'n Lang, dun, stywe deel wat 'n gewig dra wanneer daar van sy twee ente af op hom gedruk word.
items.bron: CAPS NWT Gr 4-6, p. 22: '(lede wat saamgedruk kan word is stutte)': a strut is a member in compression, which is what 'pushed from its two ends' describes.

items.bewering: bedekking: Die gras, riet of matte wat bo-oor 'n raam gesit word.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Rondavel' (thatch sewn to the poles); az.com.na (reed mats draped over the frame); Ditsong Museums (grass and reed thatch over the bent-pole dome).

items.bewering: koepel: 'n Ronde dak wat soos die boonste helfte van 'n bal buig.
items.bron: DSAE 'beehive hut': a 'semi-spherical dwelling', i.e. half a ball. Mapping checked: a beehive hut is often somewhat taller than a true hemisphere, but 'the top half of a ball' gives the right picture of a round, curved roof and leads a learner nowhere false.

items.bewering: rondawel: 'n Ronde huis met 'n muur en 'n grasdak bo-op.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Rondavel': round, a 'cone on cylinder', with a thatched roof. Modern rondavels are sometimes roofed with corrugated iron, but the definition describes the traditional form this lesson is about.

items.bewering: inheems: Iets wat van hierdie land self kom en nie van elders nie.
items.bron: Wiktionary 'inheems': originating in a place; native, indigenous.

items.bewering: tradisioneel: 'n Manier van doen wat 'n gemeenskap lank bewaar en aan jonger mense oordra.
items.bron: Dictionary.com 'tradition': customs handed down from generation to generation over a long period.

items.bewering: iqhugwane: Die Zoeloe-mense se ronde grashuis met 'n raam van gebuigde takke.
items.bron: The definition is right: Ditsong Museums describe a dome-shaped hut of bent wooden poles, thatched. The headword's spelling is not confirmed here; it is the subject of the onseker item under 'Die Zoeloe-huis' and must follow whatever that settles.

items.bewering: matjieshuis: Die Afrikaanse naam vir die Nama-mense se ronde huis van matte.
items.bron: DSAE 'matjieshuisie': from Afrikaans matjie + huis, a Namaqualand beehive-form 'hut of reed mats'.

items.bewering: Khoekhoegowab: Die naam van die Nama-mense se eie taal.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Khoekhoe language': also called Khoekhoegowab, known by the ethnic names Nama and Damara; UCT Ibali San and Khoen digital archive, 'Khoekhoegowab (Nama/Damara)'.

opsomming: The lesson holds up everywhere except the Zulu house's name: 'iqhugwane' has no authoritative support, because the national museum Ditsong spells it 'iqukwane' and the CAPS document itself calls the hut 'uguqa', so a person (preferably an isiZulu speaker) must settle the word before the sentence, the glossary entry and the word list can stand; the lesson contains no superlatives, and both comparisons (the roof truss and the half ball) were checked for their mapping and hold.
